g.text: Annual actual expenses; temporary COVID and cost-of-living programmes separated
Actual expense history / approximate grouping | Actuals from five Treasury vintages; accounting, classification and programme
coverage change. The main basket is approximate across the 2013 reform. The residual is shown rather than silently excluded.
These are nominal gross expenses, not payments solely to people without jobs.
Sources: 5 official releases; full URLs and vintages in chart catalogue and gallery
